title: Pure Azamina

allow.Deception of the Sinful Spoils: Shared Sinful Spoils card built for Azamina: tributes a monster to search any Azamina card, and drains LP while you control an Azamina monster.
allow.Sinful Spoils Subdual: Shared Sinful Spoils card: adds or summons Queen Azamina, a Level 8 Illusion, from the Deck.
allow.Sinful Spoils of the White Forest: Shared Sinful Spoils card: summons an Illusion from the hand or Fusion Summons an Azamina with real materials, and counts as a Sinful Spoils card to send.
allow.Diabellstar the Black Witch: Diabell witch the page pivots through: sets a Sinful Spoils Spell/Trap from the Deck, which the Azamina Spells then send as their cost.
allow.Diabellstar Vengeance: Diabell witch that is always treated as a Sinful Spoils card: a cost the Azamina Spells can send, and a Fiend for Moa Regina and Sol Erysichthon.

summary: Pure Azamina Fusion strategy driven by the Sinful Spoils engine and Diabellstar witches, supported by generic staples. Rather than traditional Fusion materials, Azamina Spells and Traps cheat out Azamina Fusion Monsters by sending Sinful Spoils cards from hand or field, generating recursive negation, destruction, and floodgate pressure.

summary.title: Starters
points: Deception of the Sinful Spoils sends a monster from hand or field to the GY to add any Azamina card from Deck to hand, acting as the prime connector between Sinful Spoils and Azamina Spells.
Diabellstar the Black Witch Special Summons itself by sending a card from hand or field to the GY and Sets a Sinful Spoils Spell or Trap directly from the Deck.
Sinful Spoils Subdual adds or Special Summons Queen Azamina directly from your Deck.
Queen Azamina is always treated as a Sinful Spoils card, and if sent to the GY or banished by an effect, Special Summons itself to provide continuous field presence and Tribute fuel.

summary.title: Opening: Deception of the Sinful Spoils
steps: Activate Deception of the Sinful Spoils, sending a card from your hand to the GY to search The Hallowed Azamina from your Deck.

Activate The Hallowed Azamina, sending Deception of the Sinful Spoils from your field to the GY (counting as 1 Sinful Spoils card for a Level 6 or lower Fusion) to Special Summon Azamina Mu Rcielago from your Extra Deck.
Trigger Azamina Mu Rcielago on Fusion Summon to add Azamina Debtors or Deception of the Sinful Spoils from your Deck or GY to your hand.
Activate The Hallowed Azamina's GY effect to shuffle a Sinful Spoils card from your GY into the Deck and add The Hallowed Azamina back to your hand.
Use Azamina Debtors or additional Sinful Spoils cards to climb into high-level bosses like Azamina Moa Regina.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Azamina Mu Rcielago searches any Azamina or Sinful Spoils card upon Fusion Summon and lowers opponent monsters' ATK by 100 for each Sinful Spoils card in your GY.
Azamina Sol Erysichthon sends any card on the field to the GY on summon and recovers banished or GY resources during each Standby Phase.
Azamina Moa Regina revives an Illusion monster or Level 6+ monster and destroys up to 2 cards on the field as a Quick Effect.
Saint Azamina prevents itself and opponent cards from being targeted, and Special Summons an Azamina monster directly from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Azamina is the Level 12 ultimate boss: immune to effect destruction, it renders all opponent monsters with 0 ATK unable to activate their effects or attack.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: The Hallowed Azamina and Azamina Debtors serve as pseudo-Fusion Spells that send Sinful Spoils cards from hand or field to Special Summon Azamina Fusions without requiring named materials.
Azamina Determination is a Trap variant that shuffles Sinful Spoils cards from the GY back into the Deck to summon an Azamina Fusion during the opponent's turn.
Sinful Spoils of the White Forest summons an Illusion monster from your hand or performs a standard Fusion Summon using materials from hand or field.
Azamina Aphes bounces cards on the field up to the number of Fusion and Synchro Monsters you control.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The dedicated White Forest Synchro engine is omitted here as it maintains its own standalone decklist, keeping this list concentrated on Azamina Fusion loops.
